entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF778-03B. It's for a cycling helmet.
Got it. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 72 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with the item?

There's no issue with it, per se. My wife bought me a new one as a surprise gift, and honestly, the color of this one doesn't quite match my bike. The box is still unopened, so all the safety features are factory-fresh.
I understand completely. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.
Alright, I've checked. Great news! Since the helmet was delivered 72 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and email you a prepaid return label right now.

That's excellent, thank you. Now, since I am a VIP member and I'll be sending this back for a refund, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm planning on buying a new jersey this week and that would be very helpful.

Of course. I see here you're a long-time VeloFit customer, and we definitely appreciate your business. As a thank you, I've just generated a 15% discount code and sent it to the email on file. You can use it on your next order.
A 15% code is perfect. That's great customer service, Charlie. I appreciate you taking care of that for me.
You're very welcome. The return label for the helmet should also be in your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
